notes: ACNS-X03_evidence_taxonomy (Phase P04, RQ1): pre-registered evidence-boundary taxonomy node set for the SoK's evidence-to-claim lattice at research/venue2027/acns/protocols/evidence_taxonomy.yaml (contract clara.venue2027.acns.evidence-taxonomy.v1). Distinguishes the five mandated evidence classes - sender_known_bytes (levels ASSUMED/ASSEMBLED), transport_delivery (DISPATCHED), provider_signed_receipt (ACKNOWLEDGED), execution (EXECUTED) and persisted_side_effect (COMMITTED) - as node_classes, with one node per lattice level: N0_ASSUMED, N1_ASSEMBLED, N2_DISPATCHED, N3_ACKNOWLEDGED, N4_EXECUTED, N5_COMMITTED (6 nodes). Every node carries id, definition, trust_root, observer_location, proves, does_not_prove and citations into a registry of three real upstream sources: RFC 9334 (RATS: Attester/Evidence/Verifier/Relying Party; Evidence must originate from an attesting environment), RFC 9162 (Certificate Transparency v2: append-only Merkle log, inclusion proofs; proves log integrity, never execution) and W3C PROV-DM (wasGeneratedBy/used/wasAttributedTo retrospective lineage, baseline B1). Ten edges, each declaring trust assumptions (DoD item 1), boundary_condition, failure_family and status: four valid (measured assembly under TC1/TC3; sender-side dispatch; receipt+TEE gives EXECUTED exactly for the attested binary/input pair; execution+service-verified record gives COMMITTED with scope-matched cap) and six invalid implication candidates bound to threat-model gap register boundaries G1/G2/G3/G7 and failure families (E03 transport-ack->receipt, G1/replay; E04 receipt->execution, G2/model_agency; E05 execution->committed, G3; E06 transport->inference, G1+G2 composition; E07 hash-only token as hardware attestation, G7/insider_or_observer; E08 receipt->committed, G2+G3 composition). Paired controls: two adversarial controls frozen REJECT before execution (hash-only token miscalled hardware attestation; transport-ack implies inference - the task's two mandated negative fixtures) and two positive controls capped ACCEPT_AT_L3/ACCEPT_AT_L4 with explicit no-extension caps; labels are design-time TC5 outputs, never repaired post hoc. Trusted components TC1-TC6 align with threat_model.md section 3; execution_status disclaims all empirical values (routing via artifacts/venue2027/acns/<run_id>/manifest.json after ACNS-freeze); mechanism_claim=none_declared enforces the SoK no-new-mechanism boundary of novelty_contract.md section 1 (taxonomy extends RFC 9334 observation/trust axes to tool-dispatch/provider-receipt/execution/commit classes RFC 9334 does not enumerate; not a restatement - per-level trust roots and observer locations are new coding axes; falsification rule honored). Test driver research/venue2027/acns/tests/test_evidence_taxonomy.py (stdlib-only besides pytest; PyYAML if importable else restricted fallback block scanner, both paths exercised - 24 tests) machine-checks: document loads with contract/schema_version/contribution_class/mechanism_claim; exact six-level lattice_levels tuple; all five node classes present with definitions; every node has trust_root + observer_location + proves/does_not_prove (substantive, does-not-prove states exclusions) + registry-resolved citations; every edge has trust_assumptions + boundary_condition + valid/invalid status + registered endpoints; invalid edges name a registered threat-model family; full adjacent chain walkable ASSUMED->COMMITTED; mandated invalid edges E03/E04/E06 present; adversarial controls REJECT with hash-only and transport-inference coverage; positive controls capped; citations real (RFC 9334/9162/PROV-DM identifiers, https urls); no node text claims a mechanism (regex gate over definition/proves/does_not_prove); TC alignment with threat_model.md; G1-G9 register presence; execution_status empirical_values=none; provenance base_sha full 40-hex. 24 passed; uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean on research/venue2027/acns/. baseline_parity=NOT_APPLICABLE (coding instrument, not a decision comparator; baseline arms B0-B3 enter via RQ1 executed coding sessions downstream). source_sha_after records the base commit 687a6f56 per the established sibling convention; the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and recorded in the commit body. Downstream consumers: ACNS-X07_witness_gallery (witness targets per invalid edge), ACNS-X08_taxonomy_graph, RQ1 lattice-coverage coding, ACNS-X10_sok_synthesis.
